updatedBy: CTO session (Claude) - Backline audit and qualification approval
title: bndy workboard
description: Single view of active bndy product, platform, ingestion, intelligence and growth work.
principles: Canonical BNDY APIs remain the write authority.
Capture is transport and durable intake, not the intelligence engine.
Enrichment is the strategic resolution and intelligence runtime.
BNDY Backline is the capability/product name; bndy-enrichment remains the single strategic Backline runtime rather than creating a parallel repository.
All new ingestion paths should converge on Capture + Enrichment rather than inventing another write path.
The target state is evidence -> claims -> projection -> canonical BNDY, not source -> direct database write.
BNDY Backline is the durable intelligence substrate: immutable evidence plus observations and atomised claims feed policy and projection; the graph is a derived view, not the authority.
Healthy source delivery requires both ingestion health and evidence-backed enrichment health; blank or explicitly unknown is safer than an invented classification or a wrong identity link.

repositories.role: Core public gig discovery PWA: map, gigs, artists, venues, festivals, favourites and public add flows.
Authoritative artists, venues, events, festivals, auth, curator policy, source inspection and edition-aware APIs.
Admin operations, curator policy management and traffic visibility.
Public brand, proposition, policy and architecture pages. The workboard lives here.
Public Dropzone UI for gig poster and text submission. Routes into Capture.
Durable intake transport for Android Send to bndy and public web submissions. Stores evidence and queue state.
Strategic Backline runtime for source acquisition, immutable evidence, observations, atomised claims, identity resolution, authority, projection, Capture processing and enrichment.

Live Cowork task definitions, source snapshots, cursors, state, machine run ledgers and human run reports. It is an operational evidence source for Backline, not a second strategic runtime or canonical authority.
Thin agent-facing adapter around BNDY capabilities. Needs a current-role audit as Enrichment becomes the orchestration layer.
Older Signal -> interpretation -> claims implementation. Useful concepts should be absorbed then the runtime retired.
Previous public application. Do not use for new work.
Shared type definitions used by older/newer surfaces where applicable.
Shared UI package from the earlier application generation. Audit before expanding usage.

backlog.title: Send to bndy: reliable web and WhatsApp intake
backlog.detail: Turn chat.bndy.live into a polished, mobile-first Send to bndy experience and launch a memorable WhatsApp Business number people can save. Both channels accept posters, screenshots, images, links and event text through the same Capture and Backline pipeline. Harden interpretation consistency, identity resolution, deduplication, retries and uncertain-result handling. Provide immediate acknowledgement, clear progress and a useful final result. WhatsApp remains an intake channel, not a separate chatbot or intelligence engine.

backlog.title: Poster-led Scene view for local discovery
backlog.detail: Add a future third public discovery mode alongside Map and List. Scene is a finite, location- and date-bounded visual view of canonical gigs, led by authentic posters where available and deterministic BNDY event cards otherwise. It is not a general user-post, comment or infinite-scroll social feed. Delivery is approved but deliberately unscheduled.

backlog.title: Saved gigs and Going
backlog.detail: Allow signed-in people to save a specific gig privately and separately mark themselves as Going. This slice records only those two account-backed intent states. Their eventual use will be decided later. Do not expose attendee lists or attendance counts, add curator recommendations, use either signal in Scene or Ask bndy ranking, or introduce posts, comments or follower mechanics.

backlog.title: Ask bndy natural-language discovery
backlog.detail: Add a highly polished natural-language layer to the existing discovery search. It converts intent into visible, editable deterministic filters and returns only canonical BNDY gigs through the existing Map and List experiences. It must not present as a chat interface or chatbot persona, and it must never invent gigs or unsupported attributes. Delivery depends on sufficiently rich and reliable genre, act-type, admission, date and location data. Ship only when the interaction is fast, slick and materially better than using the filters directly, never as an AI novelty.

backlog.title: Hear the bill line-up playback
backlog.detail: A much-later gig-page experience that assembles the external media already supplied through owned artist profiles into a playable Hear the bill line-up. Do not create a duplicate media-entry flow. Use third-party embeds only, with no BNDY-hosted uploads in the first version, and do not prioritise until enough active artists are supplying usable media links for the experience to feel complete.

backlog.title: Date-aware Artist booking requests
backlog.detail: Later, let a person choose an available or unlisted date on an Artist profile and send a private booking request through BNDY. BNDY should deliver it to the claimed Artist, provide in-app and explicitly opted-in notifications, and keep request status and replies inside the account experience. Decide consent, spam controls, privacy, response flow and any WhatsApp, email or text fallback before delivery. Do not expand the current availability-calendar work into messaging now. This is dependent on claimed Artist adoption and reliable notifications.

lanes.objective: Give artists and venue operators a beautiful, low-friction route to find or create their entity, authenticate, establish ownership and start managing it without creating duplicates.

done.detail: /join, /join/artist and /join/venue are live product routes with a dedicated mobile-first onboarding feature rather than the Add utility UI.

done.detail: Artist canonical/variant/location resolution and Venue Google Place identity run before creation. Existing identities branch safely to Claim rather than duplicate creation.

done.detail: Existing bndy auth is reused, Join state survives auth redirects, and Venue Google Place details are rehydrated on return.

done.title: JOIN-04/05 — owned Artist and Venue creation
done.detail: Authenticated Join endpoints recheck identity at commit and create the entity plus initial owner relationship as one logical operation. Artist uses legacy artist memberships; Venue uses generic entity memberships.

done.title: JOIN-06 — Artist profile step
done.detail: Artist type, canonical act types, acoustic capability and canonical genres are captured in the lightweight Join step using the shared taxonomy.

done.title: JOIN-07 — Claim persistence and review
done.detail: Existing-entity claims persist, appear to the claimant, and are reviewable/approvable in Godmode without overwriting the entity before verification.

done.title: JOIN-08 — management and delegation foundation
done.detail: /manage lists Artists, Venues and Claims. Venue delegates use expiring email-bound invite links and their own accounts; owners can revoke delegates and safely transfer Venue ownership.

done.title: JOIN-09 — owner authority protection
done.detail: Backline authority policy now blocks lower-authority automated mutations/destructive changes on owner-managed projections while retaining external evidence for conflict/review.

done.title: Artist profile media and lightweight availability
done.detail: Owners and admins can edit YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud and Bandcamp links and manage bookable dates directly from the lightweight public Artist profile. Public media uses mobile-first, tap-to-load embeds with no autoplay. Availability reuses the canonical model to publish exact dates or free weekends, protects real gig dates and presents a clean booking contact action. The owner routes consume active Artist memberships and do not alter Claim creation, evidence or review.

done.title: Complete repaired grounded enrichment recapture failed closed
done.detail: The approved one-shot citation-mapped recapture completed all 20 public Artist and Venue cases in shadow with zero provider errors. Seventeen identities were high-confidence and three ambiguous cases safely abstained. The strict evidence gate accepted zero facts and quarantined 99 proposals because their citations were not present as exact captured provider evidence. Measured complete-path cost was $1.8712. Canonical writes remained zero, and the provider remains unqualified and unscheduled.

done.title: Human review operating model defined
done.detail: Human adjudication is a bounded commissioning and exception-control mechanism, not a daily Product Owner dependency and not model fine-tuning. Qualification reviews known answers to prove the provider and thresholds. BAU automatically accepts only facts that pass hard identity and exact citation rules, automatically parks uncertainty, and sends only genuine conflicts plus a small periodic quality sample to designated reviewers. The Product Owner approves provider activation and canonical projection policy.

done.title: Gemini inline grounding citation repair merged
done.detail: The 20-case proof showed that Gemini Search completed reliably but structured-output mode omitted the inline url_citation annotations required by Backline. The repaired adapter now keeps one model call, requests ordinary grounded output shaped as JSON, preserves official inline citation URLs and cited text, ignores empty search queries in usage accounting, validates the response with the strict schema, and continues to quarantine arbitrary or uncaptured URLs. All 303 tests and the TypeScript build pass. No provider call or canonical write was made by the repair.

done.title: Inline-citation live proof failed closed
done.detail: The separately approved one-shot proof attempted the same 10 Artist and 10 Venue cases with one grounded Gemini call per case and at most two requested searches. All 20 provider responses returned, but none conformed to Backline's strict fact schema: identityReason was absent in every response, with additional facts-array and evidenceUrls shape defects. Backline accepted zero facts, activated no schedule and made zero canonical writes. The committed legacy artefact reports a zero measured subtotal because its parse-error path discarded usage; provider calls did occur, so total cost is explicitly unavailable rather than zero. PR 90 repairs that evidence ledger for future failures. The provider remains unqualified and unscheduled.

done.title: Split search and structured reasoning path merged inactive
done.detail: Backline now has a tested v2 qualification adapter that captures at most two explicit Google Programmable Search result sets, then gives Gemini only that fixed public evidence allow-list for one stateless schema-constrained reasoning call with no browsing tool. Exact citation, requested-predicate, token, deadline and cost controls fail closed, including preservation of public evidence and measured usage on schema errors. The command is inactive: no credentials, Lambda wiring or schedule were added, no provider call was made and canonical writes remain zero. Repository CI passed all 48 test files and 311 tests.

done.title: Google Programmable Search qualification failed closed
done.detail: The separately approved one-shot split-provider qualification attempted the existing 10 Artist and 10 Venue cohort in production shadow. Every case stopped on its first Google request with 403 PERMISSION_DENIED because the project does not have access to the Custom Search JSON API. Google now documents the API as closed to new customers. No Gemini reasoning call ran, no facts were accepted, no schedule or provider activation occurred, estimated spend was unavailable with no measured usage, and canonical writes remained zero. The public failure artefact and review were committed and the capture-failed result was published read-only to Godmode. The provider remains unqualified and unscheduled; another run requires a supported evidence-search provider and separate approval.

done.title: Explicit-contract Gemini qualification failed closed
done.detail: The approved one-shot cohort ran exactly 20 Gemini 3.6 Flash calls over the existing 10 Artist and 10 Venue cases. All responses completed and passed the JSON contract. Google grounding executed 43 searches, with Neovenator using 3 and The Humbuckers 4 despite the two-search request. Measured cost was $0.66234 against the $0.60 reservation. Gemini proposed 67 facts but supplied zero provider url_citation annotations, so Backline quarantined every fact and admitted none. Five ambiguous identities safely abstained. The public artefact and review are committed, the exact status is live read-only in Godmode, canonical writes remain zero and the provider remains unqualified and unscheduled.

done.title: Interactions evidence-first citation proof passed on Whittles Oldham
done.detail: The new inactive Gemini Interactions evidence-first adapter uses one deterministic tab-delimited IDENTITY line plus zero or more FACT lines and admits a fact only from provider url_citation metadata bound to that fact segment. The approved Whittles Oldham shadow proof made one Gemini 3.6 Flash call and two Google searches, returned six provider citations and admitted five venue facts at a measured $0.02963275 within the $0.05 reservation. The full provider response is public. Canonical writes were zero, no schedule was created and the provider remains inactive. The response also exposed cumulative citation ranges starting at offset zero; PR 116 tightens binding to the FACT line containing each citation end offset and is green but awaiting explicit merge approval. This is a one-venue transport/evidence-contract proof, not provider qualification.

now.title: Lemonrock is Backline's first national flagship source
now.detail: The committed plan deliberately bootstraps the complete discoverable UK Lemonrock artist, venue and future-gig universe into source-native identities, immutable evidence and rich Claims before selective canonical projection.

now.title: BNDY Backline is a logical layer, not another app
now.detail: It lives inside the bndy-enrichment AWS runtime: Source Registry/Runner + S3 evidence + DynamoDB observations/claims + queues/workers + projection policy. The public BNDY database remains the canonical product projection, not the intelligence store.

now.title: Dual-path operating rule
now.detail: Building durable evidence/claims must not delay live gig publication. A trusted source can create claims and immediately project through canonical BNDY APIs while BNDY Backline keeps the evidence history for later reconciliation.

now.title: Source authority is source-specific
now.detail: KLMA is a controlled enduring community calendar and can support immediate additive projection. GigsNews is a human-curated weekly aggregation, so absence from a later page is not by itself cancellation evidence.

now.title: Two generations of claims thinking exist
now.detail: bndy-signals contains the older cognitive runtime; bndy-enrichment/BNDY Backline contains the strategic architecture.

now.title: Daily Backline discovery metrics
now.detail: DEPLOYED FOR GENERIC SOURCE RUNS. Each generic run produces one 180-day drill-down metric and atomically updates one 400-day source-family daily roll-up from the in-memory report, with DynamoDB TTL and no corpus/evidence scans. Godmode now exposes recent family runs and their item, event, profile, Claim, parked-row, warning, error and duration measures. Remaining: add resolved/unresolved/conflicted and queue/cost aggregates plus historical trend charts.

now.title: Safe entity enrichment worker
now.detail: EVIDENCE CONTRACT PROVEN ON ONE VENUE, PROVIDER STILL UNQUALIFIED. The inactive Interactions evidence-first adapter requests one or two Google searches, one model call and deterministic fact lines, then derives evidence URLs only from provider url_citation annotations bound to exact output segments. Whittles Oldham produced two searches, six citations and five admitted facts for $0.02963275. The raw response showed cumulative citation ranges, so the production-safe binding must use the citation end offset rather than generic overlap; that hardening is green in PR 116 and awaits explicit merge approval. No schedule or provider activation occurred and canonical writes remain zero. A fresh balanced 20-case proof and adjudication are required before qualification.

now.title: Priority 1: Backline Trust Loop v1
now.detail: LIVE SHADOW, SINGLE-CASE CITATION GATE PASSED. Google Programmable Search remains unavailable, but Gemini Interactions with Google Search grounding has now returned machine-readable url_citation annotations when driven by the deterministic evidence-first plain-text contract. Whittles Oldham passed the transport and citation-admission proof with five facts and zero writes. This does not qualify the provider. Immediate work is PR 116 citation-range hardening, redirect-destination preservation, then a separately approved 10 Artist plus 10 Venue cohort with known-answer review, coverage, false-match and cost gates. The Product Owner will not be a daily reviewer; uncertainty remains automatically parked.

now.title: Hard gate: healthy artist enrichment
now.detail: NOT YET PASSED. The evidence-first plain-text contract has produced authoritative provider citations for one Venue case, removing the previous zero-citation transport blocker. It has not yet tested an Artist and has not established cohort-wide identity accuracy or requested-predicate coverage. Acceptance still requires zero false matches, at least 80 percent requested-predicate coverage where knowable, explicit attempted-no-official-presence outcomes, authoritative evidence mappings, stable citation destinations and complete cost control across the balanced 20-case cohort. No provider activation or canonical projection is permitted.

now.title: Embed and operationalise the evidence graph
now.detail: Integrate the existing bounded graph reader into Godmode and populate it with source identities, canonical candidates, resolution/conflict state and projection decisions. Operators must be able to search and expand from one node, see confidence and authority, and drill through to exact evidence and decision history without rendering or scanning the whole corpus.

now.title: Capture ongoing Cowork canonical activity
now.detail: CONTRACT LIVE, LEDGER INGESTION WAITING FOR FIRST RECORDS. Claude Cowork schedules remain explicit external canonical writers until replaced. bndy-ops now requires an append-only JSON ledger, human report, CTO inbox entry and canonical API read-back for every run, including no-change or failure. As at 14:34 UTC on 28 Aug the remote repository contains the v2 contract and schema but no run-ledger records, so Backline cannot yet hydrate current Cowork activity honestly. Once records arrive, ingest them as BNDY-origin Observations and Claims tagged with Cowork writer lineage and projection-suppressed to prevent a canonical feedback loop.

next.title: Controlled Backline projection
next.detail: After Trust Loop v1 passes, generate a complete shadow would-write report and review every proposed canonical action. KLMA is the first bounded additive-only candidate because its Stoke corpus is a useful known-answer cohort. The pilot must prohibit destructive changes, retain owner protection and stop thresholds, and requires separate human approval before any canonical write or Cowork writer transfer.

next.title: Bounded network discovery
next.detail: Only after identity quality is proven, add budgeted graph expansion from resolved Artists, Venues and Events. Enforce maximum depth, entities, fetches, model calls, time and cost; fully enrich selected nodes but expand edges selectively. Keep DynamoDB evidence and Claims authoritative and defer Neptune until measured graph workloads justify it.

next.title: Converge community and agent evidence
next.detail: Route Venue, Event, Festival, Capture, curator and MCP-assisted changes through durable Observations, Claims and projection policy after parity gates. Human and agent contributions should strengthen provenance and exception handling rather than bypass the Backline trust model.

next.title: Migrate useful Signals concepts
next.detail: Port useful deterministic resolvers, review semantics and intelligence concepts from bndy-signals into bndy-enrichment, prove parity, then retire the legacy runtime instead of operating two intelligence systems.

Acceptance requires evidence-backed artist type, act type, acoustic capability and genres where knowable; confirmed official links or an explicit attempted-no-official-presence result; zero wrong-artist links; and normal Trust Loop and human approval gates before canonical projection.

now.title: Cowork canonical change capture

The ledger must include per-Artist enrichment outcomes and identity evidence. This closes the gap between the one-time canonical baseline and live canonical changes while existing tasks continue to run; current mutable snapshots are not accepted as a write ledger.
